Name: (CP) Super Mario Hats
Author: MellyJustMelly
Description:
[size=4]I managed to mod in these mario hats, cause... I'm hyperfixated on the Mario franchise rn and saw there aren't
many mods for them. [/size][size=2](I guess there are more than I thought but oh well-)[/size][size=4]
So I made some hats! I like them, I think they're cute!
[/size][size=2][b]*Added Attributes in the pics apply to anything else that is not vanilla game. E.g.: The nose mustaches, the dot eyes, the peach hairstyle and the clothing. The only thing included are the hats and the data for said hats[/b][/size][size=4]
[/size]
[b]
[size=3]As for how to obtain them in-game, I have two options:[/size][/b]

[size=3]
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Obtain via Hat Mouse after a challenge[/size]
[size=3] 1. Load the mod
2. Configure how challenging you
﻿wish the challenge to be
3. Enjoy!


[/size][*][size=3]Simply buy from the Hat Mouse once unlocked[/size]
[size=3] 1. Load the mod
2. Wait to unlock the hat mouse and buy them
3. Enjoy!

[/size][/list][b]You HAVE to wait for the Hat Mouse to be unlocked for either one before buying them.
[/b]

[b][size=5]Please note only ONE mod .zip is needed therefore, depending which one you wish for.[/size][/b]



[size=3]If you downloaded the challenge version, please read below if you wish to know how to obtain them
in-game:


[spoiler]Mario Hat: Ship 50 Red Mushrooms
Luigi Hat: Ship 75 Common Mushrooms
Wario Hat: Earn 10.000G
Waluigi Hat: Ship 75 Purple Mushrooms
Toad Cap: Ship 150 Red Mushrooms
Toadette Cap: Ship 30 Magma Caps
Peach Crown: Ship 75 Peaches[/spoiler]



Now you can configure it to be harder or easier! If you believe the challenge is unbalanced, feel free to
edit the contents in the "assets" folder, via the "Condition" tags.


[spoiler][b]Easy:[/b]
Mario Hat: Ship 25 Red Mushrooms
Luigi Hat: Ship 35 Common Mushrooms
Wario Hat: Earn 5.000G
Waluigi Hat: Ship 35 Purple Mushrooms
Toad Cap: Ship 75 Red Mushrooms
Toadette Cap: Ship 15 Magma Caps
Peach Crown: Ship 35 Peaches


[b]Hard:[/b]
Mario Hat: Ship 150 Red Mushrooms
Luigi Hat: Ship 150 Common Mushrooms
Wario Hat: Earn 50.000G
Waluigi Hat: Ship 150 Purple Mushrooms
Toad Cap: Ship 300 Red Mushrooms
Toadette Cap: Ship 75 Magma Caps
Peach Crown: Ship 150 Peaches[/spoiler][/size]
